title: Changing the Subject of a Formula Flashcards

cards.front: What defines the subject of a formula?
cards.back: The variable that is on its own on one side of the equals sign.

options.text: The variable that is on its own on one side of the equals sign.
options.explanation: The subject is the isolated variable on one side of the equals sign, with the rest of the formula expressing how its value is calculated.

options.text: The variable that appears first on the left side of the equals sign.
options.explanation: A variable’s position does not determine whether it is the subject. The subject is the variable that is on its own on one side of the equals sign.

options.text: The variable that is used most often on both sides of the equals sign.
options.explanation: The number of times a variable appears does not define the subject. The subject is the variable isolated on one side of the equals sign.

options.text: The variable that has the largest coefficient on one side of the equals sign.
options.explanation: A variable’s coefficient does not determine whether it is the subject. The subject is the variable that is on its own on one side of the equals sign.
